units.source_text: 留下来的那几个女人穿着睡衣从桥上走了过来。

en.t: The women who had stayed behind came across the bridge in their nightclothes.

units.source_text: 她们往常应该已经像根棍棒，躺倒就睡了。

en.t: Ordinarily, they would already have fallen down like logs and gone straight to sleep.

units.source_text: 今天，连每晚由两人轮流打扫澡塘的事，都七个人一起干了。

en.t: Tonight, even the bathhouse cleaning that was usually done each night by two women in turn was done by all seven together.

units.source_text: 她们手头有钱，犹如欲望节的前夜……

en.t: They had money in their hands, as if it were the eve of a festival of desire...

units.source_text: 她们嘲笑穿着又肥又大的游泳衣、梳着桃瓣形发髻的阿雪，

en.t: They laughed at Oyuki, who was wearing a loose, oversized bathing suit and had her hair done in a peach-petal-shaped chignon,

units.source_text: 又回忆起夏天男客的种种许愿，感到饿极了，

en.t: and as they recalled all the wishes the male guests had made in summer, they grew terribly hungry,

units.source_text: 就恶狠狠地数落起客人们的缺点来。

en.t: so they began spitefully listing the guests' faults.
